summary:
Here is a 3-sentence summary of the child's part of the interview:

The child has been attending speech therapy groups and has learned to accept stuttering as a part of themselves, viewing it as something that makes them special. They experience more stuttering when in new or high-stress situations, but feel more fluent when speaking with people they know and trust. The child believes that stuttering can be a helpful experience, allowing them to develop coping skills and confidence, and suggests that support from colleagues and education about stuttering can be more effective than relying on tools to manage stuttering.
